notes.title: A treasure hunter’s guide #2: How a typical run REALLY feels
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there, brave soul! So you’ve decided to dive into the ruins in [i]Don’t Wake The Beast[/i], huh? Cute. Let me walk you through what a “typical run” looks like - so when you’re sprinting for your life later, you can say, “At least someone warned me.” 😅[/p][p][/p][p][b]Step one: The calm before the chaos[/b][/p][p]First things first - prep time! Before you set foot in those ruins, visit the merchant. Trust me, you’re gonna need those consumables. BUY THEM. And don’t forget your grappling hook’s loadout. 🪝

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311806/5b35c7ad6a2b89074670f632e16c00ab4a74e2ba.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Step two: The road to the vault[/b][/p][p]Now comes the fun part: the ruins. Beautiful architecture, rich history, and more death traps than you can imagine. Step wrong, and BOOM - you’re a cautionary tale. 💀[/p][p]Oh, and enemies? They’re everywhere, watching, waiting to ruin your day. Get spotted too many times, and guess what? They summon the Warden - an undead nightmare that will chase you until you hit the vault or die trying. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311806/a8111d758a037258f009e190e3031ff3f4ad20db.gif"][/img]
[/p][p][b]Step three: Grab the loot (but don’t get greedy)[/b][/p][p]Every glittering treasure whispers your name - but here’s the catch: each piece you grab makes you heavier. More gold = slower you = easier snack for whatever’s hunting you. 🪙[/p][p][/p][p]So ask yourself: Do you want to be rich, or do you want to live?[/p][p]…Actually, scratch that - grab what you can and pray. 🙏

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311806/6356e6e8de59898f775aa6bb9c744262108288f7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Step four: The big prize[/b][/p][p]Deep in the vault lies THE artifact. It’s shiny. It’s priceless. And, oh yeah - it’s guarded by a Beast the size of your worst nightmares. 🐲 You could try being sneaky, tiptoeing like a ballerina in chainmail… or you could YOLO and grab it.[/p][p][/p][p]Either way, when you take that artifact…[/p][p]The Beast wakes up.[/p][p]The floor trembles.[/p][p]And the game changes. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311806/8b20426e3b02207f42273ce03b01ef0aed4055cd.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Step five: RUN.[/b][/p][p]Forget style. Forget honor. Just run like every bone in your body wants to live another day. 🏃‍♂️💨 Grapple across chasms, dodge fire breath, and whatever you do, don’t look back. You won’t like what you see.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311806/df9c84c103df677cc9f6d6676bcf1190c2ad5819.gif"][/img]
[/p][p][b]Step six: Cash in, power up[/b][/p][p]If by some miracle you make it out, congrats - you’re officially a legend. ✨ Sell your loot, stack that sweet grain, and upgrade your gear. Because let’s be honest: you’re going back in.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311806/b9decba6a9f1d9245f033dd8dca1a3f7b6bd7e39.gif"][/img][/p][p]Because in [i]Don’t Wake The Beast[/i], greed isn’t just good - it’s the whole damn point.

[/p]

notes.title: A warning from the beast
notes.notes:
[p]You dare step into my halls… little thief? 👀[/p][p]I am the oldest flame, the last echo of a thousand silent ages. My wings have cast shadows across kingdoms, and my breath has turned stone to ash. Beneath my talons lie riches gathered over centuries — offerings, trophies, legacies of empires long turned to dust.[/p][p]And yet, you crawl in like a whisper, threadbare cloak and rusted grappling hook, seeking [i]my[/i] treasure.[/p][p]You think me blind?
You think the [b]beasts[/b] that roam these halls serve no master? Fool. They are my kin — scaled, fanged, and forged in shadow. They remember [b]what was taken[/b]. They remember [b]who dares to steal[/b].[/p][h3][b]Let me explain it to you, then.[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311806/32d9f9012b458f4d9dccb5f19913d815708ff413.gif"][/img]
[/h3][h3][b]1. Know whose hoard you disturb 🐲[/b][/h3][p]These are not [i]ruins[/i], boy.
They are [b]crypts[/b] of glory. [b]Every gem[/b], [b]every goblet[/b], [b]every blade half-buried in sand[/b] — they do not belong to you. They are etched with oaths older than your bloodline.
And when your trembling hand reaches for them, the ground listens. And I… awaken.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][previewyoutube="scIO2eoVxOQ;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]2. We are not in danger — We are the danger! 🔥[/b][/h3][p]We hunt not out of hunger, but duty.
We were [b]born to protect[/b], our senses sharpened by ages of silence. We hear your hook before it flies. We feel your breath before it fogs the stone.
You will run.
You will swing.
You will burn.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311806/67e65827b9dcda4578fdef9ffe841b9e174ccdba.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]3. Know this, little ember 🕯️[/b][/h3][p]You may survive.
You may even steal a shard of my memory and drag it back into the light.
But the deeper you go, the closer you come to [b]me[/b].
And if we meet…
Well. I hope you brought more than a torch.[/p][p][b]Don’t Wake The Beast[/b], you say?
[i]You already have.[/i][/p][p]

notes.title: A Treasure Hunter’s guide to staying alive (mostly)
notes.notes:
Hey there, fellow adventurers! :OrbGetThief:

It’s me, your charming, slightly bruised treasure hunter, writing this totally voluntary guide while catching my breath in a suspiciously cozy cave. 

You’re probably wondering: “How does one survive ancient ruins, unearth legendary loot, and outrun ravenous beasts without becoming lunch?” Well, lucky for you, I’ve got the answers—or at least the bruises to prove what not to do. :luckyclover:

[b]Step one: The grappling hook[/b] :grapplinghook:

Forget about carrying your grandma’s purse (no offense to Granny). Here’s what you’ll actually need: [b]The Grappling Hook[/b] – the ultimate tool for treasure hunters in Don’t Wake The Beast - You know, the game I’m the hero of: [b]single-player, challenging, roguelite, with procedurally generated levels? [/b]Ringing any bells? Yeah? I hope so. Getting back to the topic of grappling hooks, it is your tool for avoiding traps, and pulling loot from places you probably shouldn’t be reaching into and — most importantly:

[b]Pro tip #1: [/b]You can use the hook to make noise at a distance. Yep! Smash a pot near an enemy or just slap the wall with the hook — it’s like ringing a doorbell with explosives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311806/1bcac3d737399f7fcd1151c4b78d6522f802755a.png[/img]
Also, try not to swing like Spider-You-Know-Who. Trust me. I’ve tried. Didn’t end well. 

[b]Step two: Treasure hunting like a pro[/b] :IOTC_Treasure_Chest:

Every ruin has a story, and every story has… booby traps. To avoid becoming a permanent part of the scenery. Read the symbols. Some are ancient warnings. Some are invitations to die stupidly.

And…

[b]Pro tip #2[/b]: Keep an eye :caveblazerseyeball: out for cracked, fragile-looking walls — many hide secret rooms full of loot, lore, or occasionally… more problems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311806/c960c691023f054c1ae1b4206e265a7daf3ccd00.png[/img]
Don’t touch the shiny things… immediately. Look, I get it, they sparkle! But traps don’t reset themselves.

[b]Step three: The beast factor[/b]

Now, about the whole “don’t wake the beast” thing… yeah, good luck with that. If you’re looking for [b]dynamic escape challenges[/b], you’ve come to the right place. Those overgrown nightmares have a sixth sense for wannabe adventurers. My advice?

[list]
[*] Stay quiet – Whistling your favorite tune might feel heroic, but it’s basically a dinner bell.
[*] Run like your life depends on it (because it does). And if all else fails… maybe they like jokes? Worth a shot.
[/list]
Pro tip #3: When the beast breathes fire — DON’T panic. :SpellDisk_Fire:

You can latch onto the ceiling with your hook to avoid it (assuming you’re fast and lucky).
BUT here’s a trick — during its flame attack, the beast moves slower. If you’ve got space, you might be better off just sprinting out of the blast zone to gain some distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311806/aeec614088076721ba77e8647dfc6c1fbdb8f8c4.png[/img]
[b]Step four: Survive another day[/b]

If you’ve made it this far without tripping into a pit or losing an arm, congrats! You’re either incredibly skilled or ridiculously lucky. Just remember, the treasure is worth it… probably.So, grab your grappling hook, light that torch, and join me in the thrill of the chase. Just don’t forget: the ruins may hold ancient riches, but the beasts don’t take kindly to looters. I’ll see you out there—if you can keep up. [b]Don’t Wake The Beast is waiting for you, adventurers.[/b] But remember, it’s not the treasure that makes the story—it’s how you survive the chase.

notes.title: Don't Wake The Beast is a blend of Thief and Spelunky where you must let sleeping dragons lie
notes.notes:
The Hobbit movies are a mixed Baggins indeed - at once thunderous and thin, like butter scraped over too much bread - but one sequence I love from The Desolation of Smaug is Bilbo searching Erebor for the Arkenstone, while trying not to rouse the titular dragon from his slumber. Don't Wake The Beast is sort of that sequence plus Spelunkified procgen levels and Thief-esque stealth mechanics.

notes.title: Don’t Wake the Beast announced! A new adventure awaits…
notes.notes:
[b]Hunters! [/b]

It’s been an incredible journey since the release of Flooded, and today, I’m thrilled to finally share the first glimpse of my next project - Don’t Wake the Beast. 

While Flooded explores survival and strategy in a world consumed by rising waters, Don’t Wake the Beast ventures into entirely new territory - one that I’ve been excited to explore for quite some time already…

[b]What’s Don’t Wake the Beast?[/b]

I’ve wanted to challenge myself with a fresh genre and a different type of gameplay compared to my latest game, all while staying true to the pixel art style I hold dear. Now, after months of development, I’m excited to finally introduce you to this roguelite stealth adventure.

Just like with my previous project, this game’s journey began during a game jam, where I first brought the idea to life. Back then, it was a pure stealth game, but I felt an urge to make it more immersive… To add layers that would draw players in even deeper! 

What started as a simple experiment, quickly turned into something much more exciting.

[previewyoutube=oAE7xReD7oo;full][/previewyoutube]

In Don’t Wake the Beast, you play as a treasure hunter sneaking through randomly generated dungeons, each one fiercely guarded by dangerous enemies. Your goal? Steal the most precious treasures without alarming foes and escape before the beast catches up to you! 

Oh, and you have to know that every treasure you collect contributes to your wealth, but also increases your weight and the noise you make… 

Each dungeon features many monsters, traps, and environmental puzzles. To navigate these hazards, you’ll rely on your brain and your trusty grappling hook - a tool that’s key to opening new pathways and staying one step ahead of danger. 

In the future I’ll definitely share more about the hook itself, as it will be a crucial part of the gameplay! ;) 

[b]Trailer[/b]

I’m beyond excited to share that the game’s debut trailer premiered at The MIX Fall Showcase and is now available to watch. I hope the video gives you a taste of the adventure that awaits. 

You might have already seen it, but… Let’s do this one more time: 

[previewyoutube=-QYkj8CcPSg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Stay tuned![/b]

Of course, there’s still a lot of work ahead, but I know this will be an exhilarating journey. Working on Don’t Wake the Beast is an awesome experience, and I’m happy that I was able to finally reveal it to you all.

If the game sparks your interest, consider adding Don’t Wake the Beast to your wishlist - it means a lot to me and helps a ton. Thank you for your continued support, and I can’t wait to share more updates with you soon!
